summary: A مِكْيَالٌ (mikyal) is a device used to measure grains like corn. It refers to a specific capacity measure, similar to how we use terms like "bushel" or "liter" today.
lane: مِكْيَالٌ ذ A measure with which corn is measured; (S, Msb, K;) as also ; (Msb;) a measure of capacity.

headwords.def: اِكْتَالَ عَلَيْهِ and مِنْهُ: see عَلَى in the sense of مِنْ.
[ A measurer of corn and the like]. (A, art. بخس.)
A measure with which corn is measured; (S, Msb, K;) as also; (Msb;) a measure of capacity.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
